content: {"phoneNote":"The hero card fills the whole first screen so the shop photo only peeks in at the bottom edge, and the two product cards with icons instead of product photos feel thin.","desktopNote":"The arched hero photo works well with the framed card, but below it the product cards are hollow (icon, name, price, lots of empty space) and the gallery leaves half the width empty.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":2,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Put real product photos in the two product cards instead of the repeated olive-branch icon and tighten their height; on desktop the price floats in a dead band.","Let the gallery fill the width on desktop (larger or more photos, or a two-column with text) rather than two small squares beside an empty right half.","Shorten the phone hero so the shop photo and the arch show within the first screen; move the olive icon into the heading line or drop it."],"blockers":["Desktop, gift-package section: a thin dark band continues under the section before the gallery, reading as an empty leftover strip."]}
